name: p0_empty_household
title: Fresh install with no statements
purpose: A portfolio that has been created but never fed a statement. This is the state every new user starts in, and the state in which every literal fallback in the code becomes visible: with no primary equity symbol, no accounts and no Social Security history, anything the dashboard still displays came from a hard-coded default rather than from data.

scenarios.name: Default
scenarios.notes_md: Generated baseline for the empty-household fixture.

invariants.note: A configured-but-empty portfolio still counts as present.
Page title and header come from config, not from a literal.
No statements means no simulator buckets at all.
No accounts are invented from defaults.

notes: This fixture is the default for tests that do not declare a portfolio, so it is also the cheapest root to assemble.
